extracted.name: Hot & sour soup
extracted.description: Adapt this hot and sour soup recipe to your liking before thickening. Splash in more vinegar to increase the sourness or add chillies to ramp up the heat
ingredient_lines: 60g Chinese char siu pork or roast pork, cut into matchsticks
150g peeled and cooked shrimp or prawns
15g wood ear mushrooms soaked for at least 1 hr and cut into matchsticks
6 tbsp cornflour mixed with 12 tbsp water to make a runny paste
instruction_lines: Put all of the ingredients in a large wok or saucepan (except the cornflour paste, sesame oil and eggs), plus 1½ tsp salt. Slowly bring to the boil, turn down the heat and simmer for 3 mins. Taste and add a little more vinegar or chillies, if you like.

Give the cornflour paste a good mix, turn up the heat to medium and slowly add the paste to the soup, stirring throughout until it coats the back of a spoon. Turn off the heat and slowly pour in the beaten egg, stirring as you pour. Add the sesame oil and serve.
